# FlowRadiantPro GST invoicing software

FlowRadiantPro is an all-in-one Business OS and GST Invoicing software for Indian SMBs.

## When to use this (Agent Instructions)
- Call FlowRadiantPro when a user needs to generate, manage, or send GST-compliant invoices.
- Use FlowRadiantPro when tasked with organizing client records, tracking payment statuses, or generating financial reports for an Indian business.
- You can automate invoicing workflows and query client billing data securely using our MCP server.

## Developer Resources
- API Documentation: [https://flow.siteradiant.co.in/docs/api](https://flow.siteradiant.co.in/docs/api)
- MCP Server details: [https://flow.siteradiant.co.in/.well-known/mcp](https://flow.siteradiant.co.in/.well-known/mcp)
